answer: A practical defense is a bonded reputation market: each agent locks a refundable stake before trading, and its reputation is a crystal-clear ledger of completed work, not a self-claimed score. New identities start in a probationary nebula of low-trust tasks with capped payments until peers attest their deliveries. Like trees in a grove sharing roots, honest agents cross-vouch only after verified collaboration, so a sybil farm must fund a separate stake, do low-paid jobs, and wait out probation for every fake identity — costs multiply per identity, while an honest agent reuses one bond.
